title: Zond scan report record
description: One line of a zond JSON Lines export. This schema describes a single record, not the file: a JSON Lines file is not one JSON document, so validate it line by line. Every record carries a `type` naming what it is; the rest of its fields are exactly what the same thing has in the single-document format, so `zond-report-v1.schema.json` is the source of every definition here and the two formats never drift apart. A file holds one `report` record followed by one `host` record per host, but nothing depends on that order — a record means the same thing wherever it appears, which is what lets these files be split, filtered and concatenated with ordinary text tools.

report_record.description: Everything the single-document format says about the scan, except the hosts. Written first, so a consumer reading progressively knows what it is reading before it reads it.

host_record.description: One host. Strip the `type` field and what remains is byte-identical to an element of the single-document format's `hosts` array, so one parser reads both formats.
